DisplayName: Phishing message click and suspicious URL
Notes: Mailbox telemetry shows the user opened a simulated phishing message and clicked the embedded link. Ask the student to review sender, URL, and follow-on sign-in activity.
Query: OfficeActivity_CL | where UserId_s == 'adele@contoso.com' | where Operation_s has 'MailItemsAccessed' | take 5

DisplayName: Two distant sign-ins for the same account
Notes: Two sign-ins for the same account appear too close together to be physically possible. Students can inspect account, IP, and location context.
Query: SigninLogs_CL | where UserPrincipalName_s == 'student01@contoso.com' | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName_s, IPAddress_s, Location_s

DisplayName: Suspicious process tree on lab VM
Notes: A suspicious process launched from the Downloads folder and spawned PowerShell with encoded command content. Students can use this to discuss process ancestry and containment.
Query: SecurityEvent_CL | where Computer == 'AZWIN-LAB-01' | where EventID_s in ('4688','1116') | take 10

Notes: A user downloaded many documents in a short period. Students can review whether this is expected business activity or possible data collection.
Query: OfficeActivity_CL | where Operation_s has 'FileDownloaded' | summarize Downloads=count() by UserId_s

DisplayName: Failed RDP attempts followed by success
Notes: Multiple failed logons were followed by a successful RDP session. Students can compare source IP, target host, and account name.
Query: SecurityEvent_CL | where EventID_s in ('4625','4624') | where LogonType_s == '10' | take 10
